assessment.intent: Help a small business owner define and evaluate the practical deliverables of a branding project before approving it.
assessment.specificity: High: names positioning, message hierarchy, visual system, photo direction, templates, file ownership and a checklist table.
assessment.evidence: Mostly practical recommendations, clearly framed as a checklist rather than guaranteed outcomes; no invented client results.
assessment.voice: Connected, conversational, Canadian-spelled, answer-first sections without corporate padding or flagged filler language.
assessment.usefulAsset: Yes, as a practical buying and briefing checklist for a small-business branding project.
